svg.title: Pelican riding a bicycle
svg.desc: A white pelican with a long orange bill and a big orange throat pouch rides a burgundy bicycle to the right along a seaside road at golden hour. It sits on a leather saddle, its webbed orange feet rest on the pedals and the black tips of both wings grip the handlebar. A wicker basket of fish rides on the front rack, and a low sun, the sea, a sailboat and gliding pelicans fill the background.
